subject: Mid-quarter cohort: pipeline hygiene, stage updates & targeted save plans
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Mid-quarter cohort: pipeline hygiene, stage updates & targeted save plans

Team —

As we cross the mid-point of Q1 I want a short, focused push on pipeline hygiene. Finance asked for a snapshot by end-of-week for the cohort we'll include in the Feb 23 forecast. Key asks:

- Please update stage + expected close date for every active commit in the attached Q1_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx.
- Flag deals red/yellow/green using the rubric at the top of the sheet. Red = customer has procurement blockers or exec misalignment; Yellow = product/POC dependency or pricing discussion ongoing; Green = on track.
- For each red deal include a 2-sentence save plan (owner + next milestone) and whether you'd like manager escalation.

I'm including the cohort list below (only deals >$100k ARR). I'll follow up with an internal triage meeting Friday at 10am PT for any reds.

Initial flagged items (fill in details in the sheet):
- Acme Analytics — Stage: Contracting — Flag: RED — Notes: procurement asking for data residency proof, looking to push to next quarter.
- FinOps.ai — Stage: Negotiation — Flag: YELLOW — Notes: waiting on final legal language; commercial signed.
- Nimbus Retail — Stage: Commit — Flag: GREEN — Notes: POC completed; exec signoff scheduled.

Please have updates in the sheet by EOD Thursday so Finance can bake them into the rolling forecast. If you need a one-off approval (credits, temporary SLA exceptions) mark it in the "Escalation" column and tag Laura so she can triage.

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q1_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter cohort: pipeline hygiene, stage updates & targeted save plans

Thanks — I've updated the sheet with the latest from my book. Quick notes inline for the three I own: 

> Acme Analytics — Stage: Contracting — Flag: RED
- Update: Procurement pushed back asking for a certified SOC2 statement and a short data-retention addendum. Had a call with Raj Patel yesterday; he confirmed they won't sign without a legal caveat removed. I've uploaded my redline (Acme_contract_redline.pdf).
- Save plan (owner: Monica): Schedule procurement sync + counter-proposal by 02/17; if no movement, request manager escalation for a one-time bridging credit.

> FinOps.ai — Stage: Negotiation — Flag: YELLOW
- Update: Sophie (vendor) wants minor changes to payment terms. Commercial ok with current pricing. Expect close by 02/25.

> Nimbus Retail — Stage: Commit — Flag: GREEN
- Confirmed exec signoff for 02/20.

Action items I need:
- Approval path for a one-time bridging credit for Acme if procurement remains stuck (estimate $25k credit to unblock).
- Legal to confirm if the data-retention clause in my redline is acceptable.

Forwarding snippet of the procurement mail I received:

Appreciate the update, Monica.

Acme is a likely ARR-critical account for this quarter and we shouldn't let procurement gatekeep without escalation. Proposed path:
- Laura: can Finance bless a one-time $25k bridging credit (to be reconciled at renewal) if Monica confirms the contract checkbox to limit exposure?
- Monica: prepare a 15-min procurement + legal + revenue ops sync for Wednesday 02/18 9am PT. Please include the redline and the short save_plan_template.md (see my notes in the sheet).

If Finance can't approve the credit we should discuss a limited concession (shorter term, higher MR) that preserves ACV. I can join the call if needed.

On a separate note: please mark the HubSpot deal ID in the sheet so Finance has a direct link (I've added it to related_links).

-Karthik

- Next steps: Monica to get legal confirmation on the retention clause and upload final contract by EOD 02/19. Karthik offered to join the final procurement handshake.
- Owner & milestone: Monica — send redlined contract to Raj (02/19) and move to final DocuSign link.
